name: Three-Cube
definition: The graph on all binary triples, with two triples adjacent when they differ in one coordinate.
properties: It is a hypercube, median graph, maximum class, ample class, and partial cube. Its VC dimension and isometric dimension are both three, so it is not a two-dimensional partial cube and is not an ample class of rank at most two. Every proper pc-minor has VC dimension at most two.
